analyst_view.overall: Early view: Villarreal (8th, mixed form) host Rayo Vallecano (14th), whose coach Beñat San José was under pressure after fan protests in October. Villarreal host Sabah in the Champions League on the Tuesday before, leaving five days' rest. Rayo are without goalkeeper Augusto Batalla (until January) and centre-back Luiz Felipe (long term).

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals. I lean slightly higher: Rayo are missing their first-choice goalkeeper and a starting centre-back, and Villarreal at home with five days' rest should create plenty.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.9 corners. I found nothing on either side's style or team news that moves this, so I stay with it.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.1 cards. Rayo's 2.7 expected cards already reflects an away side under pressure; Renato Veiga's ban should be served well before this game. No referee yet.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.6 shots. Nothing in the news points either way; Villarreal's midweek game is at home and gives them five days to recover.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.2 shots on target. I lean a little higher, in line with goals, given the gaps in Rayo's defence.
